description:
Open a session with a key that has passed one admission here, without a challenge. Sign "lockzone-session-v1
<public_key>
<minute>
<name>", where minute is the Unix time divided by 60. One session per key per minute; the session is not rechecked and has the usual budgets. The signature is yours to make; the lobby holds no keys.
name: lockzone.admission.key
title: Return with a proven key
